Area Knee and hip Sets 4 Each set Hold 45 seconds How often Every other day Set by Elin Nyström Profile Profile How to do it Loop a heavy band around a sturdy post and step into it so it sits behind both knees. Step back until the band is tight, feet hip width apart. Sit back into a squat, keeping your shins upright as the band holds your knees. Hold, breathing slowly, then stand up.
